name: identity
note: hand-provable, so no capture was needed: mapPoint computes round(x / from.width * (to.width - 1)) with a [0, to.width - 1] clamp, which returns x unchanged while x <= from.width / 2 — round(100 / 1080 * 1079) = round(99.9074) = 100 and round(200 / 2316 * 2315) = round(199.9136) = 200. It is deliberately NOT a general identity: the same 1080-wide screen maps x = 1079 to 1078, so this fixture pins only mid-range points.
